title: Choose the visual world for your portfolio
question: Bolder hand. The deal led with the Night-Market Sign River. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Night-Market Sign River
options.lineage: night-market streets: lanterns, awnings, hand-painted boards
options.thesis: Your portfolio is a night market: a river of saffron lanterns leads visitors past stalls, each system you shipped a stall with its own hand-painted sign, ending at a stall where you can talk to him.
materials: hand-painted sign boards and awning stripes
steam as the divider between districts
options.viewport: A dark street at night; a string of lanterns sways across the top and lights up one at a time; your name hangs as the market's big painted gate sign, and the lantern river bends down toward the first stalls.
options.risk: Can tip into theme-park if signage gets cute; every sign must still read like a clear label.

raised.raise: Flat fills only: every sign is flat ink with no gradients or shading, and state changes by swapping hue.
One colour flattens the night: saffron lantern light is the only glow on the page.
A live simulation: the lantern river responds to the pointer and reroutes toward the stall you hover, like an agent routing a request.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Your work as a departures board: projects are trains, status and stack are columns, and every change clatters letter by letter.
options.viewport: A full-width board whose top row flips into your name, with rows for each shipped system below.
options.case: Everyone reads a departure board instantly; loses boldness to the night market.
options.risk: One-note if the board is the only idea.

options.label: Hand-Drawn Tech Zine
options.thesis: Your LangGraph pipeline explained like a friend sketching on a napkin: marker diagrams, doodle arrows, highlighter swipes.
options.viewport: A marker headline with a doodled pipeline drawing itself in on load.
options.case: Best at making the agent pipeline clear; loses on audience identification for senior roles.
options.risk: Cream paper and doodles can read junior.

options.label: Push Pin Poster
options.thesis: Flat candy silhouettes with ribbon hair.
options.case: Needs illustrated portraiture that does not exist.
options.kept: Flat fills, state by hue swap.

options.label: Indoor Weather Sun
options.thesis: An amber haze hall with a mirrored sun.

options.label: Gravity-Rain Garden
options.kept: A live simulation as the signature interaction.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean modern developer portfolio, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name and role, primary CTA, project grid below.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other engineer's portfolio by design.
